title: Add langfuse instrumentation
description:
The following environment variables must be added to .env:

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
LANGFUSE_HOST

If these are not available, the app will still work, you just won't get any instrumentation.

See https://langfuse.com/integrations/model-providers/anthropic

title: tests(gh-actions): Add nightly & CI tests
description:
Add a smoke test that checks if shiny assistant is available and able to respond to user queries when 
- A team member creates a PR (Runs against the local version of shiny assistant)
- Nightly at 0300 hrs. (Runs against the deployed version of shiny assistant)
